title: IncidentEvent
description: A normalized event representing an anomaly or issue detected in the system.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific event occurrence.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred.

source_service.description: Name of the service/pod/component where the issue originated.

summary.description: Brief, human-readable description of the issue.

technical_details.description: Raw data, logs, or metrics associated with the event.

correlation_id.description: Optional ID to group related events.
